g.text: Source: nothing. Every number here is invented to show the layout. Notes: the em dash marks a measurement that was not taken, which is not the same as a zero. Shaded cells are the strongest value in their

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Verdana', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5c5b57

g.text: row, including the one row where that is not the highlighted column. Super Saiyan 1 and 2 sit within a few percent of each other on every row but hair.
